tests.name: Test 1.1 - Fresh recovery reply appears after conflict
tests.purpose: Confirm the chat sends a new reply with current replacement slots instead of leaving the user on the old widget.

rows.action: Open the main chat and load available slots.
rows.what_is_tested: The standard slot-list widget is present before the conflict path starts.

rows.action: Trigger the known slot-conflict path for one of the shown slots.
rows.what_is_tested: The conflict branch is entered for the selected slot.

rows.action: Inspect the next assistant reply after the conflict.
rows.what_is_tested: A new reply is returned with fresh replacement slots.

rows.action: Select a replacement slot from the new reply.
rows.what_is_tested: The flow continues correctly from the fresh recovery reply.

tests.name: Test 1.2 - Previous widget becomes non-interactive
tests.purpose: Confirm the outdated widget cannot be reused after the fresh recovery reply appears.

rows.action: After the fresh recovery reply appears, try interacting with the previous widget.
rows.what_is_tested: The old widget is disabled and no longer acts as the active recovery source.

tests.name: Test 2.1 - ChatSandBox.html parity
tests.purpose: Confirm the same recovery follow-through exists on the matching sandbox surface if it shares the interaction path.

rows.action: Repeat the same conflict-and-recovery path in ChatSandBox.html if it uses the same booking interaction path.
rows.what_is_tested: The sandbox surface shows the same fresh recovery reply behavior and disables the previous widget.
